Am mers la un curs de gătit.
en: As I kept living alone, I ended up learning to cook.
I went to a cooking class.
I can't cook at all.
I live with my family.

correct.ro: Trăind singur/singură, am ajuns să învăț să gătesc.

Am citit despre culturile din lume.
en: As I kept traveling a lot, I got to know new cultures.
I've never traveled.
Traveling hasn't taught me anything.
I read about world cultures.

en: As long as I'm healthy, I'll continue working.

Orașul nu e nici convenabil nici zgomotos.
en: The city is convenient, but on the other hand it's noisy.

Vara și iarna sunt la fel.
Vara este friguroasă și iarna este caldă.
Nu îmi place nici vara nici iarna.
en: Summer is hot, whereas winter is cold.
Summer and winter are the same.
Summer is cold and winter is hot.
I don't like either summer or winter.

correct.ro: Vara este caldă, în schimb iarna este friguroasă.
correct.en: Summer is hot, whereas winter is cold.

en: I ate all the cake.

I bought a new wallet.
I left my wallet at home.

Am terminat masa și apoi am primit un apel.
Am sunat pe cineva în timp ce mâncam.
Am mâncat după ce am vorbit la telefon.

I finished eating and then got a call.
I called someone while eating.
I ate after talking on the phone.

correct.ro: În timp ce mâncam, a venit un apel telefonic.

ro: În timp ce ascultam muzică, am adormit.
Am oprit muzica și am adormit.
en: While listening to music, I fell asleep.
I woke up from the music.
I turned off the music and fell asleep.
I listened to music all night.

correct.ro: În timp ce ascultam muzică, am adormit.
correct.en: While listening to music, I fell asleep.

I love exams.
Exams are easy.
I can't wait for the exam.

correct.en: I wish there were no exams.

Abia aștept să mă întorc la școală.
en: I wish the vacation were longer.
The vacation is too long.
I don't like vacation.
I can't wait to go back to school.

correct.ro: Mi-ar plăcea ca vacanța să fie mai lungă.
correct.en: I wish the vacation were longer.

ko-ro.q: 알람이 안 울리는 바람에 늦잠을 잤어요.

Am dormit prea mult pentru că am vrut.
Alarma a sunat și m-am trezit.
Am setat alarma dar am uitat-o.
en: Because the alarm didn't go off, I overslept.
I overslept because I wanted to.
The alarm went off and I woke up.
I set the alarm but forgot it.

correct.ro: Din cauză că alarma nu a sunat, am dormit prea mult.
correct.en: Because the alarm didn't go off, I overslept.

Am sunat dar nu mi-a răspuns.
Nu am vrut să iau legătura.
en: Because my phone broke down, I couldn't contact anyone.
I called but no one answered.
My phone is working fine.
I didn't want to contact anyone.

correct.en: Because my phone broke down, I couldn't contact anyone.

Restaurantul are prețuri accesibile dar mâncarea nu e bună.
Nu îmi place nici mâncarea nici prețul.
en: This restaurant is not only delicious, but the price is also cheap.
The restaurant is delicious but expensive.
The restaurant has cheap prices but the food isn't good.
I don't like either the food or the price.

correct.en: This restaurant is not only delicious, but the price is also cheap.

Sportul e bun pentru sănătate dar obositor.
Nu fac sport pentru că e greu.
en: Exercise is not only good for health, but also helps with stress relief.
Exercise is good for health but tiring.

Exercise causes stress.

This law doesn't exist.
Citizens made this law.

Oamenii de știință au respins tratamentul.
Tratamentul a fost inventat de pacienți.
en: A new treatment was developed by scientists.
Scientists rejected the treatment.
The treatment was invented by patients.
There are no new treatments.

ro: Aceasta este o carte pe care o citeam des pe când eram student/studentă.
Nu am citit niciodată această carte.
en: This is a book I often read when I was a student.
I just bought this book.
I've never read this book.
This book is new.

correct.ro: Aceasta este o carte pe care o citeam des pe când eram student/studentă.
correct.en: This is a book I often read when I was a student.

ro: L-am întâlnit după mult timp pe prietenul cu care mă jucam împreună.
Nu mi-am văzut prietenul de mult.
Voi merge să-mi văd prietenul mâine.
en: I met a friend I used to play with after a long time.
I met a new friend.
I haven't seen my friend in a long time.
I'll go see my friend tomorrow.

correct.ro: L-am întâlnit după mult timp pe prietenul cu care mă jucam împreună.
correct.en: I met a friend I used to play with after a long time.

ro: Am început o campanie cu intenția de a proteja mediul înconjurător.
Am participat la o campanie de mediu.
Mediul înconjurător nu are nevoie de protecție.
en: We started a campaign with the intention of protecting the environment.
We participated in an environmental campaign.
I'm not interested in the environment.
The environment doesn't need protection.

correct.ro: Am început o campanie cu intenția de a proteja mediul înconjurător.
correct.en: We started a campaign with the intention of protecting the environment.

ro: Exersez în fiecare zi cu intenția de a-mi îmbunătăți abilitățile.
en: I practice every day with the intention of improving my skills.
I practice sometimes when I have time.
I don't practice at all.
I practice for fun.

correct.ro: Exersez în fiecare zi cu intenția de a-mi îmbunătăți abilitățile.
correct.en: I practice every day with the intention of improving my skills.

ko-ro.q: 그렇게 똑똑한 사람이 모를 리가 없어요.

ro: Nu este posibil ca o persoană atât de inteligentă să nu știe.
Este posibil ca persoana să nu știe.
en: There's no way that such a smart person doesn't know.
That smart person doesn't know.
The person is not very smart.
It's possible that the person doesn't know.

correct.ro: Nu este posibil ca o persoană atât de inteligentă să nu știe.
correct.en: There's no way that such a smart person doesn't know.

Este posibil să îmi fie foame.
en: I just ate, so there's no way I'm hungry.

I haven't eaten anything today.
It's possible that I'm hungry.

correct.ro: Tocmai am mâncat, deci nu este posibil să îmi fie foame.
correct.en: I just ate, so there's no way I'm hungry.

Atmosfera de azi este foarte bună.
Atmosfera a fost mai rea ieri.
en: As you can feel, the atmosphere today is not good.
The atmosphere today is very good.
I don't feel anything special today.
The atmosphere was worse yesterday.

correct.ro: Cum puteți simți, atmosfera de azi nu este bună.
correct.en: As you can feel, the atmosphere today is not good.

Rezultatele au fost surprinzător de bune.
Nimeni nu s-a așteptat la aceste rezultate.
en: As expected, the results were not good.
The results were surprisingly good.
No one expected these results.
The results haven't been announced.

correct.ro: Cum era de așteptat, rezultatele nu au fost bune.

Am ascultat sfatul și a mers bine.
en: If I hadn't listened to those words, I wouldn't have made a mistake.
I listened to the advice and it went well.
I made the mistake on purpose.
I didn't listen to any advice.

correct.en: If I hadn't listened to those words, I wouldn't have made a mistake.

Am adus umbrela și m-a ajutat.
Am uitat umbrela acasă în mod intenționat.
en: It would have been good if I had brought an umbrella.
I brought the umbrella and it helped.
I don't need an umbrella.
I intentionally left the umbrella at home.

correct.ro: Ar fi fost bine dacă aș fi adus umbrela.
correct.en: It would have been good if I had brought an umbrella.

en: This book is worth reading.
This book is not worth reading.
The book is too difficult.
I haven't read this book.

Nu merită să vizitezi acest loc.
Nu știu unde se află acest loc.
en: It's a place worth visiting.
This place is not worth visiting.
The place is too far.
I don't know where this place is.

correct.ro: Este un loc care merită vizitat cel puțin o dată.
correct.en: It's a place worth visiting.

Let's eat together tomorrow.

correct.en: That movie turned out to be really touching.

This is an official opinion.

en: That reason was nothing more than an excuse.

en: Due to exam stress, I'm almost at the point of crying.

correct.ro: Ca urmare a râsului excesiv, m-a durut burta.
correct.en: As a result of laughing too much, my stomach hurt.

ko-ro.q: 걱정한 나머지 밤새 잠을 못 잤어요.

I went to bed early.

correct.ro: Ca urmare a îngrijorării excesive, nu am putut dormi toată noaptea.
correct.en: As a result of worrying too much, I couldn't sleep all night.

en: All I can do is be grateful.
I'm not grateful at all.
I have no reason to be grateful.

en: All I can do is silently move forward.

correct.ro: Tot ce pot face este să merg înainte în tăcere.

en: The more you learn, the better you can do.

It's not worth learning more.

correct.ro: Cu cât înveți mai mult, cu atât poți face mai bine.
correct.en: The more you learn, the better you can do.

ro: Pe măsură ce te pregătești, capătă încredere.
Orice ai face, nu ai succes.
en: The more you prepare, the more confidence you gain.
Preparation doesn't matter.

correct.ro: Pe măsură ce te pregătești, capătă încredere.

correct.en: I tried to hold back, but ended up getting angry.

My diet is going perfectly.

correct.ro: Sunt la dietă, dar am mâncat tort până la urmă.
correct.en: I'm on a diet, but I ended up eating cake.

I arrived at the office on time.
